In the long path, two independent exponential completion clocks and exact terminal return lengths give a rational polynomial strictly positive for L>=2. All assumptions and boundary cases h=1 and M>=32 are explicitly handled. value.rationale: The motivating 2026 paper states the equal-order arbitrary-radius extension as an explicit open problem. It is mathematically natural because an observer may know the graph order even when only a local neighborhood is visible. The family shows that order cannot rescue bounded-radius predictability even with marked degrees, distance and resistance supplied. This is a genuine structural strengthening, not a routine algebraic restatement or arbitrary finite slice.
